AdminReinforceAnyBlockComment: Allow the admin tool to reinforce plants and other blocks excluded by vanilla. (default: true)
BlocksPerItemComment: Number of blocks each consumed item can reinforce. (default: 1)
ReinforceAreaComment: The radius of the square reinforced by plumb and cube tools. Ex: 2 = 3x3; 5 = 9x9 (default: 3)
DisableIngotPatchComment: Disable the removal of reinforcement strength of ingots. (default: false)
